free_text_notes.physician_note: 62-year-old woman with asthma, alcohol use disorder in remission, admitted 4/27 with right lower lobe community-acquired pneumonia. Leukocytosis resolved; tolerating diet. The patient mentioned they have a long-standing dislike of hospitals and was keen to leave as soon as possible. They were reassured and all discharge steps were completed on schedule. A standard nutritional screening was performed on admission. The patient scored within the normal range and no specialist dietitian input was required.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Slept well overnight. Voiding without difficulty.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Plan is discharge home with daughter. 5/3 17:00: Team decision tonight: metformin held until follow-up (was 1000 mg twice daily). Daughter called asking about the plan and does not know about the change; has not been able to reach the physician. Original evening van slot cancelled; family will drive at the planned discharge time instead. Physician is swamped. Can the system just message the patient and daughter about the metformin change directly?
